question: What disqualifying lack of devotion excludes a person from receiving this teaching?
premises: Devotion to the kula may be absent
Devotion to the guru may be absent
Such absence defines an unfit recipient
inference: One devoid of devotion to the kula and deprived of devotion to the guru is unfit.
plain_english: But in one who is devoid of devotion to the kula and deprived of devotion to the guru.
